serviceDetails.title: What is a landlord gas safety certificate (CP12)?
paras: A yearly gas safety check is a legal must for landlords. We check the boiler, cooker, and other gas fittings, then give you the paperwork you need. The record is known as a CP12.
serviceDetails.alt: Landlord gas safety check CP12 certificate

serviceDetails.title: How quick is the check?
paras: We work around your tenants and get the check done with little fuss. You get your certificate fast, well before your due date.
serviceDetails.alt: Engineer carrying out fast landlord gas safety inspection

faqs.q: How often do I need a gas safety check?
faqs.a: Once a year for each rented home, by law.

faqs.q: Is a CP12 the same as a landlord certificate?
faqs.a: Yes. A CP12 is the record you get from a landlord gas safety check.

faqs.q: How long is a CP12 valid?
faqs.a: One year. Book your next check before the date runs out.

faqs.q: What if a fault turns up?
faqs.a: We tell you straight away and can often fix the fault the same day.
